title: iSawIt - BCI
_comment: Generated by build_config.py from the BCI CSVs (Barro Colorado Island, Panama). 'n' = scientific name (what gets recorded), 'c' = common name (optional; app falls back to 'n'). Extra common names live in common_names_extra.csv. 'n' = display name. taxa = Quick list; taxaFull = optional full checklist. Insects: Quick holds only the first 50 species as a test; the full list (all species in the CSV) is in taxaFull and selectable at session start.
